shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,200p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && sed -n '1,160p' .lore/test-commands.yml && git status --short"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git branch --show-current && git log -1 --oneline && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,100p' && rg -n \"changelog|CHANGELOG\" .github scripts package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD && git diff -- CHANGELOG.md && git diff -- package.json src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts | sed -n '1,260p' && git status --short && rg -n \"reanchor\" scripts/spec-links || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md CHANGELOG.md && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '20,75p' && sed -n '10,28p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git diff --check && git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md CHANGELOG.md'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && timeout 300 npm test -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts --runInBand'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "fix(tools): preserve schema error paths" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git status --short --branch && git status --porcelain=v1'
